\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]\footnotesize
\item \textit{Notes.} QLIKE is the mean over the \rhrDays{} trade days (2020-01-03 to 2024-04-30, early closes excluded) of the daily loss $L_t = RV_t/\hat\sigma^2_t - \log(RV_t/\hat\sigma^2_t) - 1$, with the plain forecast $\hat\sigma^2_t = \hat y_t^2 B_t$ (no recalibration) and $RV_t$ the winsorised 15:30--16:00 realised variance. $\Delta = 100(\overline{L}^{\,\text{pooled}}/\overline{L}^{\,\text{per-bar}} - 1)$, the same estimator and input set. DM is the Diebold--Mariano statistic of the daily QLIKE difference (pooled minus per-bar), with a Bartlett Newey--West variance at lag 6 and the Harvey--Leybourne--Newbold correction; $p$ is two-sided (normal). Positive $\Delta$ and DM favour the per-bar fit. $t$ is the Newey--West $t$ (lag 14) of the daily difference of the midpoint straddle returns (pooled minus per-bar). Bold: $p < 0.05$. Per-bar trees: fixed settings refit every session; pooled trees: the bank's walk refit at every bar (24,000-bar window); linear models are pre-tuned in both fits. The pooled MinGRU is refit monthly (each refit on its trailing 24,000 bars), not at every bar like the pooled trees; both MinGRU fits are ridge-initialised and trained and selected on QLIKE. $^\dagger$The pooled forest on all features is interim (16:00 forecasts; the full walk is still running).
\end{tablenotes}
